The '''Droid ion blast Mark III''' was [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech's]] highly adavnced weapon against [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and was often thought to be the most feared weapon by droid army commanders. The drawback was found in the unit's power consumption. The internal circuitry could only withstand a few shots before self-destructing.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
